senses.gloss: m.(ch. form) (קְפַץ; cmp. קָפִיץ, a. קֶפֶץ) [curved cutting tool,] hatchet or bill for chopping bones.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 21:4">Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 4</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="S00508"><he>קוּפִיץ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>אין מבקעין … אלא בק׳</he> you must not split wood (on the Holy Day for immediate use) with an axe …, but only with the butcher’s hatchet.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:6">Ib. III, 6</cite> <he>כנגד הק׳</he> by putting on the scale a hatchet (instead of the commercial weights); Y. ib. 62ᵃ bot. <cite ref="S00507"><he>קופיס</he></cite>.
Pes. 70ᵃ ק׳ קשורה וכ׳ (fem.) the hatchet tied to the slaughtering knife; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 1:17">Tosef. Bekh. I, 17</cite> <he>עורפו בקוּפָּץ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>בקֻפִּיץ</he>) he breaks its neck with a hatchet from behind.
